story.title: The Decibel Deal
story.logline: A desperate street musician trades his future words for instant fame, only to realize the silence he bought has a terrible price.
story.theme: The true cost of unearned applause.
story.twist: The massive crowd cheering for him consists entirely of people who have also lost their voices.
story.ending: Who are you really applauding for when no one can make a sound?

scenes.narration: My voice is gone forever, and tomorrow the whole city will finally scream my name.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22 years old with messy dark hair and a faded leather jacket, stands in a neon-lit alley.

scenes.narration: Seven days ago, a sleek broker offered me eternal fame if I signed away every spoken word.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, in a neon-lit alley, holding a glowing digital contract.

scenes.narration: I laughed, but my guitar had stayed silent for years. Hunger makes a man trade his soul.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, in a neon-lit alley, staring down at his dusty acoustic guitar.

scenes.narration: I pressed my thumb on the glass. The contract vanished, and pure electricity flooded my fingertips instantly.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, in a neon-lit alley, pressing thumb to glowing screen.

scenes.narration: Tonight, I step onto the biggest stage in London. Thousands wait in absolute, breathless anticipation.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, stepping onto a massive stadium stage under blinding spotlights.

scenes.narration: I strum a single chord. The sound shatters the night air, heavy and rich beyond belief.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, on stadium stage, aggressively strumming his glowing guitar.

scenes.narration: The crowd erupts into a deafening roar. Thousands of fans surge forward, chanting my name over and over.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, on stadium stage, looking out at a massive cheering stadium.

scenes.narration: I smile and try to shout thank you, but no sound comes out of my open mouth.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, on stadium stage, shouting silently with a desperate expression.

scenes.narration: Then I look closer at the front row. Every single person is screaming, but their mouths remain completely closed.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, on stadium stage, staring in horror at the silent roaring crowd.

scenes.narration: They gave up their voices for this too. Who are you really applauding for when no one can speak?
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy dark hair, faded leather jacket, on stadium stage, standing alone amidst thousands of silent, cheering fans.

caption.hook: He traded his words for wild applause.
caption.title: The Decibel Deal
caption.caption: The stadium roared with deafening approval for his every note, showering him in the fame he always craved. But as he bowed to the adoring masses, he noticed a terrifying detail in the front row: every mouth was open in a silent scream. What is a standing ovation worth when nobody can speak the truth?
